title: The parcel was left at the door

lines.en: Marco, I found a box in the hall. It was left outside your door this morning.
lines.pt: Marco, achei uma caixa no corredor. Ela foi deixada na frente da sua porta hoje de manhã.

lines.en: Thanks, Owen. Was it delivered by the postman, or was it left by a neighbour?
lines.pt: Obrigado, Owen. Foi entregue pelo carteiro, ou foi deixada por um vizinho?

lines.en: It was delivered at nine. The note says it was left here because nobody answered.
lines.pt: Foi entregue às nove. O bilhete diz que foi deixada aqui porque ninguém atendeu.

lines.en: I was at work. Another parcel was returned last week, and I was angry.
lines.pt: Eu estava no trabalho. Outra encomenda foi devolvida semana passada, e eu fiquei com raiva.

lines.en: Really? My parcel was returned too. It was sent back to the shop without a call.
lines.pt: Sério? A minha encomenda também foi devolvida. Foi mandada de volta para a loja sem ligação.

lines.en: This time the box was left in the hall. Was it damaged or opened?
lines.pt: Desta vez a caixa foi deixada no corredor. Foi danificada ou aberta?

lines.en: No, it was not opened. The tape was still on it, and the name was clear.
lines.pt: Não, não foi aberta. A fita ainda estava nela, e o nome estava legível.

lines.en: Good. Was the lift repaired? The door was stuck all week, and the courier was late.
lines.pt: Bom. O elevador foi consertado? A porta ficou emperrada a semana toda, e o entregador se atrasou.

lines.en: It was repaired on Monday. A new button was put in, and the stairs were cleaned.
lines.pt: Foi consertado na segunda. Um botão novo foi colocado, e as escadas foram limpas.

lines.en: Great. My parcels were always left outside before, so I will ask you to take them.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Minhas encomendas eram sempre deixadas lá fora, então vou pedir para você pegá-las.

lines.en: Of course. Two parcels were delivered to my door yesterday, so one more is no problem.
lines.pt: Claro. Duas encomendas foram entregues na minha porta ontem, então mais uma não é problema.

facts.big: It was left at the door
facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was / were + particípio: was left, was delivered, was returned.

facts.label: foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was com uma coisa: The box was left at the door. The lift was repaired. Depois de was, use o particípio, como left, delivered ou repaired.

facts.label: foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use were com várias coisas: Two parcels were delivered. The stairs were cleaned. Were serve para plural e para you.

compare.ask: It was left at the door.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “foi deixada na porta” e “foram entregues ontem”.
compare.tip: Diga: “It was left at the door.”
compare.us: Em inglês, o passivo no passado usa was ou were + particípio: was left, were delivered. Use was com singular e were com plural: The box was left. The parcels were returned.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: It was left at the door.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

items.s: The parcel was left means someone left it.
We use was with I, he, she and it.

items.why: We say The parcels were left.

answers: The parcel was left means someone left it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

We say “The parcels was left.” → Falso (We say The parcels were left.)

paragraphs: It is a windy evening in Glasgow. Marco comes home from work. He lives on the third floor. Owen lives next door. There is a box in the hall. Both men talk about parcels.

You

Owen
